title: Mixed Event — Carnation Recollection — Episode6 Forgotten Happiness

meta.Event Outline: Despite Kanade's persistent efforts to save Mafuyu, none of the songs she composes seem to leave an impression on her. Feeling like she's reached a dead end, Kanade heads to SEKAI for advice...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Hm? Kanade, you have something on your cheek.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line:
Your other cheek, silly.
Just stay still for me.
Oh, are you sure about that?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: Kanade isn't the only one with something on their cheek, honey.

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line:
Mommy, look!
Daddy did the same things as me!

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line:
It's on this cheek.
Stay still now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line:
There, got it.
Were you trying to copy Kanade, dear?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: Careful not to trip and fall, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: Mommy, look! The butterfly stopped on the flower!

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: Yes, I see. Butterflies love to eat flower nectar very much, so it must be lunchtime for it too.

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line:
It's eating a flower for lunch?
Do flowers taste good...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line:
These are carnations.
They're my favorite type of flower.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: Kanade, wait! Please don't run off like that!

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: Let's give daddy a big round of applause!

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: That one? Well, I sort of just played it off hand, so it doesn't really have a name...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line:
But let's see...
We can call it, “Kanade and Mommy's Happy Sunday”...!

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: Haha! That's such a silly name!

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: Kanade, you know it's not nice to say things like that. You'll make your father sad.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: As long as my music makes you and your mother smile, I'll be more than happy.

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: Me smiling makes you smile too, daddy?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Yes, it does. It makes me feel all warm and fuzzy inside.

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line:
Really?!
Then I promise to smile lots and lots!

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Would you mind playing us that song one more time, honey?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: You got it! Get ready for an encore!

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: I suppose I just can't help it...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: Your father's music always finds a way to make me smile.

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line:
Yeah, me too...!
I love the music daddy plays!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: This is what my parents and I saw.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What?!
But this isn't really a glamorous flower field. It's just a bunch of flower beds...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No, I got it!
You came when you were little, so it looked a lot bigger than it really was!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, you may be right.
Sorry for the confusion...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, that's totally fine! I'm just glad that we found it! There really are a lot of carnations here, huh?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Remembering what happened that day's making me feel worse.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Even after Mizuki went through the trouble of finding this place. But if I recall any more than this, I might...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: This place really means a lot to you, doesn't it, Kanade...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sorry, it's just that I'm glad to have learned that because you hardly ever talk about yourself or stuff like this, you know?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You had this great expression on your face when you saw these flowers too. You seemed so happy.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, I'm glad we did this...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Nevermind, ignore that last part! Look at me...! Talking like I know everything about you...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I wouldn't have been able to remember anything if it weren't for you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Like my memories from when I was little and why I liked this place so much.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Would you mind telling me more? About what happened back then and stuff?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: My parents and I came here on a picnic.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Dad even brought his guitar and sang for us.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It was a really simple song, but it was so gentle and happy...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Because of that, listening to it usually cheers me up.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You're talking about that music box your dad made, right? It has to be good if you're willing to say this much. It'd be great to listen to it sometime too...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I can bring it with me next time if you want...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like you to hear it too.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (When is the last time I talked about my past like this...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I'd forgotten about what happened back then for so long...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Or rather, I kept it locked away in the back of my mind...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (We were so happy back then, remembering it all now felt painful...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I'm glad I was able to.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (This place meant so much to me, and it still does...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But what are the odds that one of my favorite places would turn out to be this kind of blast from the past for you, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm not sure I would've been able to handle what I just felt if I came here alone.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I was able to look back on what happened then with a more open mind thanks to you, Mizuki.
